title: Hacker-Style Encrypted Messaging Interface
overview: Development of a high-fidelity, production-grade single-page application (SPA) featuring a cyberpunk-themed messaging interface. The application aims to provide an immersive 'hacker' experience through a Matrix-style Canvas background, glassmorphic UI elements, and simulated decryption animations for incoming messages.

userStories.want: A visually immersive 'Matrix' digital rain background
userStories.soThat: The interface feels like a high-security, underground terminal.
The user experiences a sense of security and high-tech interaction.
The 'hacker' experience is accessible across all devices.

functionalRequirements: Implement a full-screen HTML5 Canvas animation simulating 'Matrix' digital rain with varying speeds and glow effects.
Create a glassmorphic chat window and input field using a Cyber-noir/Cyberpunk aesthetic (Black/Neon Green).
Implement a 'Decryption in Progress' animation for incoming messages before they become readable.
Display status indicators including a 'Security Level' badge (e.g., 'AES-256 Active') and a pulsing 'Connection Status'.
Provide a sidebar for 'Active Nodes' or 'Encrypted Channels'.
Integrate a scanline overlay and text flicker effect to mimic a terminal interface.
nonFunctionalRequirements: Canvas animation must be optimized for high-performance rendering (60fps).
The UI must be fully responsive across desktop and mobile viewports.
Animations must be smooth, utilizing Framer Motion or CSS transitions.
The application must use Tailwind CSS for styling and Lucide icons for UI elements.
acceptanceCriteria: The Canvas 'Matrix' rain animation renders smoothly without performance degradation.
Incoming messages transition from a 'Decryption' state to a 'Readable' state.
The UI adheres to the specified color palette (#000000, #00FF41) and glassmorphic styles.
The layout adapts correctly to mobile screen dimensions.
Scanline and flicker effects are visible but do not obstruct readability.
